config.primary_metric: mean per-origin average precision (A1), R_adj, h=8

risk_sets.R_adj: established filer AND unentered pair AND >=1 event strictly before t in another track of the same category

training_grid.through: origin - h (strict purge t' + h <= t)
training_grid.cells: candidate cells at every quarter, same risk set

baselines.B1: company base rate (weighted, prior strength 2.0 toward prevalence)
baselines.B3: B1 x B2 renormalised to training prevalence

bootstrap.degenerate_handling: per resample and origin AP is computed only when the origin has >=1 positive and >=1 negative; the per-origin mean is taken over computable origins and the count is recorded; if more than 5% of resamples have fewer than ceil(25/30 * n_origins) computable origins the bootstrap is UNRELIABLE and no CI is quoted
bootstrap.reliability_gate: UNRELIABLE if >5% of resamples have fewer than ceil(25/30 * n_origins) computable origins
bootstrap.mde: MDE = (z_0.975 + z_0.80) * bootstrap sd of the delta

permutation.scheme: labels shuffled among cells sharing (origin quarter, track): every origin's prevalence and every (origin, track) entry count are preserved; per-company total entries are NOT preserved (infeasible within the frozen risk sets). Training and evaluation labels are permuted and M1C and B1 are refitted on the permuted training labels.
permutation.note: A4 resource fallback may reduce the permutation count; the achieved count and the 1/(n+1) resolution floor are reported

feature_definitions.firm_act_4: log1p(count of company material events, all tracks, with t-4 < qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.firm_act_8: log1p(count of company material events, all tracks, with t-8 < qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.firm_growth: raw_count_4 / (raw_count_8 - raw_count_4 + 0.5); rise over the last year vs the prior year
feature_definitions.firm_tracks: number of distinct tracks the company has any material event in by t
feature_definitions.firm_entry_rate: company first-entry events (new track entries) in (t-32, t] divided by 8.0
feature_definitions.adj_act_8: log1p(count of company events in other tracks of the pair's category, t-8 < qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.adj_share: same-category share of the company's events in (t-8, t] (raw ratio); None when the denominator is 0
feature_definitions.track_act_8: log1p(count of industry material events in the track with t-8 < qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.track_entrants: number of distinct companies that have entered the track (first event) by t
feature_definitions.track_recent_entries: log1p(count of first entries into the track in (t-8, t])
feature_definitions.track_age: (t - first observed industry event in the track with qidx <= t) / 4.0; None if none yet
feature_definitions.cat_share: share of the company's ever events (qidx <= t) in the pair's category; None if no events
feature_definitions.firm_size: log1p(count of company material events, all tracks, with qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.tr_track_8: fusion D: log1p(device-trial events in the track, t-8 < qidx <= t) from data/b040_device_trials.sqlite
feature_definitions.tr_adj_8: fusion D: log1p(device-trial events in other tracks of the same category, t-8 < qidx <= t)
feature_definitions.pub_prev_year: fusion D: log1p(OpenAlex works in calendar year year(t)-1); None if the year is absent
feature_definitions.pub_3y: fusion D: log1p(sum of works over complete calendar years year(t)-3 .. year(t)-1); None unless all three years are present
feature_definitions.pub_growth: fusion D: works[year-1] / (works[year-2] + 0.5); None if either year is absent

deviations_and_limitations: R_adj condition 3 uses events with qidx strictly before t (protocol section 3 wording 'before t'); conditions 1-2 use qidx <= t
Growth features (firm_growth, track_growth) are ratios of raw counts; the log1p transform is applied to the count features themselves, per the section 5 table
Fusion D features are undefined before 2016-Q1 and are median-imputed for pre-2016 training cells, so the D-vs-C test is a conservative estimate of multi-source value
Per-company and per-category AP are means of within-origin AP (never pooled across origins) because model score scales are not comparable across origins (A1)
Pooled AP is reported as a secondary metric only (A1)
The panel's event_qidx is the availability quarter; the decision-date approximation documented in protocol section 2 is inherited

Feature-integrity incident: the first real run's leak audit exposed that company_cat_q was built in pair-record order instead of sorted order, so the bisect in Panel.features returned wrong adjacency counts (adj_act_8 / adj_share / cat_share). The replay (features_bruteforce) was correct. The index is now sorted, a regression test covers it, and this run refits every model on the corrected matrix; the replay audit reports 0 mismatches.

independent_replay.tolerance: exact equality is expected (identical integer event counts and identical float operations); the check compares to 1e-12
independent_replay.method: independent linear-scan replay of the 15 features (protocol section 12.3)
independent_replay.note: the first real run reported 184/300 mismatches. Root cause: company_cat_q was built in pair-record order instead of sorted order, so the bisect in Panel.features() returned wrong adjacency counts (adj_act_8 / adj_share / cat_share). The replay was correct. The index is now sorted (regression test: test_all_bisect_indexes_are_sorted) and this run refits every model on the corrected feature matrix.

H1.criterion: H1 supported iff the 95% CI of mean-per-origin ΔAP (M1C - B1) excludes 0 and the point estimate is positive (protocol section 7, amendment A1)

multiple_testing.reason: the pre-registered Holm correction across the two confirmatory horizons cannot be completed because h4_secondary_M1C_minus_B1 produced no quotable bootstrap CI (UNRELIABLE); the estimable horizon h8_primary_M1C_minus_B1 is reported UNCORRECTED and is not claimed as a family-wise-corrected rejection. The primary confirmatory criterion is the CI, not this correction.

permutation_test.note: labels permuted within (origin quarter, track); feature set C, R_adj, h=8; secondary descriptive test, not part of the confirmatory family

permutation_secondary_test.note: single-horizon label-permutation test (feature set C, h=8, 200 permutations); pre-declared as a robustness/descriptive check, not part of the two-horizon confirmatory family, and no Holm correction is applied to it

robustness_estimand_R_full_h8.interpretation: pre-registered robustness estimand (R_full); it may not be substituted for the primary estimand R_adj (protocol section 3)

H1.overall_verdict: H1 is SUPPORTED on the primary estimand R_adj|h8 (ΔAP 0.0584, 95% CI [0.0020, 0.1213], p=0.045). The pre-registered robustness estimand R_full|h8 is supported (ΔAP 0.0300, CI [0.012772482184809711, 0.06992508902593629]); it may not be substituted for the primary estimand. The overall H1 verdict is: confirmed on the primary estimand, with the pre-registered robustness estimand R_full|h8 in the same direction; the h4 secondary horizon has no quotable CI (bootstrap UNRELIABLE) and is not part of this verdict.
